locked_invariants: Football forecasts cannot consume sportsbook inputs.
Market movement cannot rewrite football forecasts.
Missing football evidence is never converted to zero or healthy.
Forecast capture is pre-kickoff, immutable, frozen HOLDOUT only.
Recommendations use model probability -> no-vig market probability -> edge -> EV -> PICK/PASS.
No forced pick is allowed when thresholds are not met or markets are incomplete.
Settlement evaluates previously frozen forecasts only.
Calibration can affect future versions only and cannot rewrite historical forecasts or settlements.
Production lifecycle has one autonomous scheduler and one atomic repository commit per cycle.
Operations UI is read-only and cannot reproduce or mutate model math.
No automatic wagering or stake sizing exists.
